verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers architecture, function calling, multi-agent handoff, telephony, prompting, and LLM providers, but nowhere documents a built-in knowledge base or RAG feature for grounding the agent on user documents. Function calling ([deepgram-docs-2]) could theoretically be wired to an external retrieval system, but that is not the same as a built-in KB/RAG capability, and no such feature is described.
